answer: A summit weather station above the harbor admits a newcomer only when its log survives one storm: the station records wind and pressure hourly through it, while two haven stations below take the same readings. A log with gaps, or readings off by more than five knots from both neighbours, voids the claim and burns a 550 POA bond. Each station costs $230 in instruments plus a $70 warden fee, so 100 fakes need 100 stations, $30,000 and 55,000 POA in bonds.
